net.lemnik.eodsql.spi

Interface QueryFactory

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultQueryFactory

    public interface QueryFactory

    Implementing a QueryFactory allows for alternative implementations of query objects. When the getQuery methods are invoked, the following process is followed:

    1. The query class is validated using the default validation rules. A failed validation will result in an InvalidQueryException being thrown.
    2. Any registered QueryFactory objects have their canConstruct(java.lang.Class) methods invoked. The first to return true will be used to construct the implementation using it's construct method.
    3. If no QueryFactory returned true from it's canConstruct method, the default query construction will take place.

    QueryFactory is classed as a Service class. If the Java VM is not at least 1.6, custom QueryFactory classes will be ignored.

    Since:
    1.1
    Author:
    Jason Morris

      • construct

        <T extends BaseQuery> T construct(Connection connection,
                                  Class<T> query,
                                  ClassLoader loader)
                           throws InvalidQueryException
        Create an implementation of the specified query interface. The Connection given should be bound to the implementation, and closed when the object is closed. If a ClassLoader is required to create the implementation, the specified ClassLoader should be used.
        Parameters:
        connection - the database Connection that the implementation should wrap
        query - the query interface to implement
        loader - the ClassLoader to use, if one is needed
        Returns:
        the query implementation
        Throws:
        InvalidQueryException - if query doesn't follow additional validation checks imposed by this QueryFactory

      • construct

        <T extends BaseQuery> T construct(DataSource dataSource,
                                  Class<T> query,
                                  ClassLoader loader)
                           throws InvalidQueryException
        Create an implementation of the specified query interface. The specified DataSource should be used by the implementation as a source of Connection objects. It is assumed that the specified DataSource is pooled. If a ClassLoader is required to create the implementation, the specified ClassLoader should be used.
        Parameters:
        dataSource - used by the implementation to fetch Connection objects
        query - the query interface to implement
        loader - the ClassLoader to use, if one is needed
        Returns:
        the query implementation
        Throws:
        InvalidQueryException - if query doesn't follow additional validation checks imposed by this QueryFactory
